## The question

Public-health advice often discusses sleep, but does it address the timing and quality of light exposure? Guidance can shape what people and institutions recognise as a health-relevant environment.

## The project

Map how a defined international sample of public-health guidance addresses light and circadian health. Examine the specificity, audiences and evidence base of recommendations, while recognising differences in language, remit and national context.

## What you will do

- Develop a transparent sampling and search strategy for public guidance.
- Code how documents discuss daytime light, evening light and daily timing, and trace cited evidence.
- Compare patterns and gaps using reproducible summaries and carefully contextualised interpretation.

## Possible scope

A thesis could produce a comparative policy analysis. A shorter placement could focus on one region, language or type of guidance. Public-health, policy or communication backgrounds are welcome; additional language skills may expand the scope.
